borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Increasing the height of the rear roof of second floor level including the erection of a new dormer roof extension to replace the existing rear roof extension, and removal of existing roof terrace at second floor level to the rear elevation; relocation of 1no rooflight and installation of 2no new rooflights at main roof level; erection of a single storey rear extension to the side of the existing back addition; installation of new sliding doors at lower ground floor level to the rear elevation; alterations and enlargement of the front lightwell including the erection of new staircase; enlargement of the existing window at first floor level to the rear elevation; replacement of existing door and window with new enlarged sliding doors and extension of existing roof terrace with new replacement balustrades at upper ground floor level to the rear elevation; erection of new steps in the rear garden; removal of the front glass canopy; replacement of existing windows with new windows.
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
